lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.title: Correction and reflection: feedback and problem escalation

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can complete a realistic feedback and problem escalation task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.
scenario: At the fictional Riverbend Books, Ms.
safetyNotes: Riverbend Books and Ms. Castellano are fictional; no real supervisor, timesheet, or employer is involved.
Any request to falsify hours or records is a signal to stop and involve a trusted adult rather than resolve it alone.
materials: learner-local: the two feedback notes on this task sheet

tasks.directions: Analyze the complete worked example on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-model-card before beginning.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Complete the fictional coached case on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-guided-card, use criterion-specific feedback, and finish its fresh correction turn.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Choose the permitted real-life route or complete fictional route on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-independent-card; follow every step and retain only the named minimal evidence.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Complete the minimal evidence record on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-evidence-record; omit or fictionalize private details.

prompts.text: In your own words, what is one general signal that tells you a piece of workplace feedback has crossed from 'something to fix myself' into 'something to tell a trusted adult about'?

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Revision quality: The revised response takes honest ownership of the learner's part and states one specific fix. | Escalation judgment: The second note is correctly identified as needing escalation, and the response names the false-hours request specifically. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner draft a short, calm sentence they could actually say to a trusted adult to explain the second note, practicing saying it out loud once before writing the final version.

productionDepth.practicalGoal: I can complete a realistic feedback and problem escalation task, document the result with minimal private data, and revise a step that does not meet the lesson criteria.

duration.elapsedWindow: Up to seven days; use only the check-ins explicitly named in the task
duration.sessionPattern: 8–10 minutes model and planning, 8–10 minutes guided try, 20–30 minutes application, 7–10 minutes evidence and revision
duration.adultTime: No adult time required unless the learner chooses support

localMaterials.label: paper or a document
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

localMaterials.label: the two feedback notes on this task sheet
localMaterials.availabilityRule: Use only when already available, safe, permitted, and appropriate. The complete fictional route replaces unavailable real-world access.

materials.noPurchaseRule: No purchase is required. Use the complete fictional route when a local material, setting, source, or adult is unavailable.

resources.title: feedback and problem escalation worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: At the fictional Riverbend Books, Ms.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact feedback and problem escalation decision or action.
Model move 2: Read Ms.

Model move 3: Revise the rough first-draft response so it takes ownership of the learner's own part in the returns-bin problem, states one specific fix for next time, and drops the defensive framing, while staying honest instead of pretending it was entirely one person's fault.

Model check: Revision quality: The revised response takes honest ownership of the learner's part and states one specific fix. | Escalation judgment: The second note is correctly identified as needing escalation, and the response names the false-hours request specifically.

resources.title: feedback and problem escalation action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal, constraints, and privacy boundary for feedback and problem escalation.
2. Analyze the worked model and identify why its sequence meets the criteria.
3. Complete the guided case and use feedback before moving on.
4. Select the permitted real-life route or the complete fictional route.
5. Carry out the task, retaining only the minimum evidence named in the record.
6. Compare the result with the success checks and complete the correction loop when needed.

resources.title: feedback and problem escalation coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: At the fictional Riverbend Books, Ms.
Coach direction: Read Ms.
Learner prompt: Name one specific thing about the rough first-draft response that makes it sound defensive rather than accountable.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: feedback and problem escalation complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Revise the rough first-draft response so it takes ownership of the learner's own part in the returns-bin problem, states one specific fix for next time, and drops the defensive framing, while staying honest instead of pretending it was entirely one person's fault.
Response 1 (t2-p1): Write your revised response to Ms. Castellano's first note here.
Response 2 (t2-p2): My revised response takes ownership of my own part without either over-blaming myself or blaming the previous shift entirely.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

resources.title: feedback and problem escalation minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: In your own words, what is one general signal that tells you a piece of workplace feedback has crossed from 'something to fix myself' into 'something to tell a trusted adult about'?

Success checks: Revision quality: The revised response takes honest ownership of the learner's part and states one specific fix. | Escalation judgment: The second note is correctly identified as needing escalation, and the response names the false-hours request specifically.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: feedback and problem escalation supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional feedback and problem escalation condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Revision quality: The revised response takes honest ownership of the learner's part and states one specific fix. | Escalation judgment: The second note is correctly identified as needing escalation, and the response names the false-hours request specifically..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guidedFirstAttempt.setup: At the fictional Riverbend Books, Ms.
guidedFirstAttempt.prompt: Name one specific thing about the rough first-draft response that makes it sound defensive rather than accountable.
coachMoves: Ask the learner to name the condition.
Point to one model step only.
Give feedback against one observable success check.
guidedFirstAttempt.successCondition: Revision quality: The revised response takes honest ownership of the learner's part and states one specific fix.

simulationRoute.title: feedback and problem escalation — complete fictional route
simulationRoute.directions: Complete the feedback and problem escalation task using the fictional condition and invented, non-sensitive details on the delivered independent card.
simulationRoute.completionCondition: Complete the same decision, procedure, evidence, and revision checks as the real-life route. No adult attests that a physical event occurred.

independentTask.privacyAlternative: The learner may use invented names, dates, amounts, organizations, spaces, and circumstances whenever real details are unnecessary or private.

learnerEvidence: one revision when a step changed
evidence.reflectionPrompt: In your own words, what is one general signal that tells you a piece of workplace feedback has crossed from 'something to fix myself' into 'something to tell a trusted adult about'?
observableCriteria: Revision quality: The revised response takes honest ownership of the learner's part and states one specific fix.
Escalation judgment: The second note is correctly identified as needing escalation, and the response names the false-hours request specifically.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Revision quality: The revised response takes honest ownership of the learner's part and states one specific fix. | Escalation judgment: The second note is correctly identified as needing escalation, and the response names the false-hours request specifically.
retry.returnPath: Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g8-u05-l06-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.

guardianInvolvement.role: Optional coach only; no guardian attestation is required.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.
doNotCollect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations
account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details
photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
